rationale: Coordinated contraction of the internal cluster (nodes 4,6,10,11,12,13,15,16) into a tighter y-range (21–32) eliminates vertical detours—especially the 18-step route from 0→16 and the 13-step 4→10 path—by aligning fanin to AND gates (10,11) and OR gate (12) on shared y=24/26 rows, reducing congestion around x=24–26. The routing order prioritizes early fanout (0→8,0→16), then critical-path fanin (1→4,2→6), followed by reconvergent paths (4→10,6→11) before merging at 12 and propagating to outputs; this protects timing-critical edges with low detour cost and avoids late-resolution conflicts.
